name: Menander Protector
bio: Menander Protector is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to c. AD 600.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the first volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Books I–VI) (Book I: 101).

poems.title: Book I, 101: On a Persian mage who became a Christian and suffered Martyrdom
poems.author: Menander Protector
poems.text: I, Ispozeres, was formerly a mage among the Persians, my hope resting on pernicious fraud. When my city was in flames I came to help, and a servant of all-powerful Christ came too. He extinguished the force of the fire, but none the less, though I was worsted I gained a more divine victory.
